messages:
aparna: quick flag  CI caught broken snippets in docs/optimize after yesterday's runtime change (quant API rename + caching hint change).

jess: can you paste the failing lines?

samir: java snippet: NoClassDefFoundError for com/redwood/optimize/QuantProfile. YAML lint: unknown key 'batch_size'. caching example expecting 'prefetch: true'.

aparna: plan: small docs-only PR to update snippets, add a one-paragraph migration note, and add a grep-based docs CI check for the old symbols. keep changes scoped to docs/optimize.

riley: I'll update java/node/py snippets to use the new package and change batching examples to use max_batch_tokens/token_budget. I'll also normalize caching examples to use prefetch_hint: low|medium|high.

jess: I'll open the PR and run tools/snippet-runner locally before pushing. PR will include MIGRATE_QUANT_PREFETCH.md with before/after mappings.

samir: suggest adding a tiny grep CI job that fails on `QuantProfile|batch_size|prefetch: true` so we don't regress.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending)  triggered by jess on branch fix/optkit-snippets.

jess: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4820  includes snippet fixes, migration doc, and grep check. running snippet-runner now.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success)  snippet tests passed.

aparna: merged. follow-ups: matt to add grep rule to central docs CI next sprint, and riley to sweep archived guides for legacy keys. thanks team :rocket:
